chunks: Humayd ibn Ziyad from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from Ja'far ibn Sama'ah, and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Abdullah ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam, all from Aban, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed the Umrah of al-Hudaybiyyah, and made up the Umrah of al-Hudaybiyyah from the following year, and from al-Ji'rana when he returned from al-Ta'if; three Umrahs in total, all of them in the month of Dhi al-Qadah.
ai.seo_question: How many Umrahs did the Prophet perform in Dhi al-Qadah and where were they located?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies the specific chronology and nature of the Prophet’s Umrahs, identifying the Umrah of al-Hudaybiyyah, the compensatory Umrah of Qabdah (often associated with the following year), and the Umrah at al-Ji'rana upon return from al-Ta'if, all occurring in Dhi al-Qadah. Shia scholars utilize this narration to establish the Sunnah of performing Umrah in the sacred month of Dhi al-Qadah, reinforcing the ritual purity and timing emphasized in Hajj jurisprudence. The mention of al-Ji'rana highlights the Prophet’s practice of combining pilgrimage rites with military or diplomatic movements, illustrating the practical application of ritual obligations during the early Medinan period.
